title: Re-anchor four formal rules to active successor articles + generation restamp
summary: Narrow convergence amendment. (1) formal_rule_registry: re-anchors four participating rules whose controlling provisions were superseded to their declared active article successors under provision_supersession_edges - FR-SOVEREIGN-TO-CORE-ENGINE: A132->B162 (full-successor), FR-NO-SUB-SOVEREIGN-ALL-MODULES: B158->B162 (full-successor), FR-XINGCHENG-AUTONOMOUS-TRAINING-UPGRADE: D131->A134 (complete-successor), RULE_TEST_SUITE_CARDINALITY: B103->B110 (cardinality-clause-only successor carrying the test-suite cardinality clause). controlling_provision_hash restamped to sha256-canonical-json-utf8-v1 over {provision_id,provision_type,subject,rule,prohibition,exception} of the new controlling article per the binding spec declared and executed in generation-bound-unified-closure-20261002-r2 (B162 value cross-verified against in-registry RULE_CAPABILITY_DISPATCH row); semantic_hash recomputed over the same descriptor with the new provision id. All four rules retain status=evaluator-parity-verified, parity_status=VERIFIED, evaluator/test-contract hashes and parity_evidence_id unchanged - predicates and evidence schemas untouched. (2) version_identity restamped to successor for all 79 participating rules and validated_against_version restamped for all 77 machine_schema_parity_evidence rows (content hashes unchanged; verified 77/77 at predecessor). Closure bookkeeping, metrics and governance state are recomputed in-pipeline at publication. NOT touched: RULE_SQL_GOVERNANCE_CLOSURE and RULE_DELEGATED_A498 remain anchored to superseded provisions whose declared successors are non-article instruments (closure-definition CLOSURE_DELEGATED_A516; formal-rule self-delegation) - article re-anchor selection is a normative governor decision and stays CONTROLLING_PROVISION_NOT_ACTIVE / INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; no normative-surface, directory, obligation, duplication or external-signature fields changed.
origin: worker devin-desktop codex-implementation convergence; evidence: provision_supersession_edges live query at head 2026-10-02T13:44:01Z; hash spec = executed amendment generation-bound-unified-closure-20261002-r2 declared binding (sha256-canonical-json-utf8-v1); companion code fix: ClosureBookkeeping/evaluator now accept the governed producer's VERIFIED registry label (previously unreachable PASS demand made MACHINE_SCHEMA_CLOSURE structurally unclosable)
problem: Four participating formal rules still anchor to superseded controlling provisions (A132,B158,D131,B103) even though provision_supersession_edges declares active article successors (B162,B162,A134,B110); their closure findings reduce to CONTROLLING_PROVISION_NOT_ACTIVE. Machine-schema parity evidence is generation-bound and drifts stale each publish; registry parity label VERIFIED is the governed producer terminal state.
acceptance: all 4 re-anchored rules satisfy every evaluator predicate: registered evaluator, active controlling article, current version_identity, evaluator-parity-verified status, four 64-hex hashes, nonempty parity_evidence_id
B162-anchored rules carry controlling_provision_hash identical to the in-registry RULE_CAPABILITY_DISPATCH B162 binding (evidence-derived)
remaining FORMAL_RULE_CLOSURE findings = exactly RULE_SQL_GOVERNANCE_CLOSURE and RULE_DELEGATED_A498 (non-article delegation successors; governor-scope anchoring decision)
no predicate, required_inputs, pass/fail decision, severity, evidence_schema or provision text modified
